Subject: Feedback on Your Budget Increase Request

Hi [Name],

Thank you for submitting your request for a budget increase. After reviewing the proposal, we have decided not to approve it at this time. The current justification does not fully align with our company’s immediate financial priorities.

However, we are open to reconsidering this if you can provide more context. Please resubmit your request with a more detailed explanation, including concrete examples of the anticipated benefits and how they support our broader strategic goals.

Let me know if you have any questions or need clarification on the financial strategy.

Best regards,

[Your Name]

***
